h.modelcraft.place: Place as mesh objects in the model
h.modelcraft.nomodel: The ModelCraft model is not ready.
h.modelcraft.none: There are no members to place: lay a roof out first.
h.modelcraft.pick: Take outline from the selected face
h.modelcraft.noface: Select a flat face (the roof's plan, such as a floor or a slab top) first.
h.modelcraft.limit.meshes: ModelCraft: each truss is one mesh object (its timber pieces as closed boxes), painted in the species colour; not editable as faces, and not tied to any roof you drew. Re-laying out and placing again replaces the group.
h.modelcraft.limit.roofs: ModelCraft has no roof model to read: type the roof outline, or take it from a selected face. Hips and valleys come from the straight skeleton of that outline at one pitch; per-edge pitches and gables need BimCraft's roof tool.
